THIRD-PARTY NOTICE — TI runtime-support routines (push_rts/pop_rts)

This effect binary was built at -O2 and contains the register-save helper
routines __c6xabi_push_rts/__c6xabi_pop_rts, assembled from the source file
lib/src/push.asm of the TI C6000 Code Generation Tools, which TI licenses
under the BSD-3-Clause terms below. Everything else in the binary is
original code by its author.
